name: Auto Steam Calculator
author: pponce; calculation and pitcher heuristic inspired by Damian / Damian-AU (DSx2)
description: Estimate steam duration from milk weight using your calibration. Inspired by Damian's DSx2 calculator. This estimates temperature through time; it does not measure milk temperature.

smallJugGrams.label: Small empty pitcher (g)
smallJugGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty small pitcher. Leave blank or 0 if not configured.

mediumJugGrams.label: Medium empty pitcher (g)
mediumJugGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty medium pitcher. Leave blank or 0 if not configured.

largeJugGrams.label: Large empty pitcher (g)
largeJugGrams.description: Untared weight of the empty large pitcher. Leave blank or 0 if not configured.

singleDrinkGrams.label: Usual milk per drink (g)
singleDrinkGrams.description: Milk only for one drink; used to infer pitcher size in Auto. This can differ from your calibration milk weight.

singleDrinkJug.label: Pitcher normally used for one drink
singleDrinkJug.description: Select small or medium to choose the pitcher-detection thresholds.

weightMode.label: Scale weight mode
weightMode.description: Gross includes the empty pitcher. Tared is milk only: pitcher size cannot be inferred and no pitcher weight is subtracted.

referenceMilkGrams.label: Calibration milk weight (g)
referenceMilkGrams.description: Milk only, excluding the pitcher, from your measured calibration run.

referenceSeconds.label: Time to your desired milk temperature (s)
referenceSeconds.description: Actual steaming time in the calibration run. Use similar milk, starting temperature and steaming technique for subsequent drinks.

referenceFlow.label: Auto steam flow (ml/s)
referenceFlow.description: Flow used for calibration and applied in Auto steam mode. Configurable from 0.4 to 2.5 ml/s; default 0.4 ml/s. Recalibrate the time if you change this flow.

defaultJug.label: Starting pitcher selection
defaultJug.description: Small, Medium or Large subtracts that pitcher weight. Auto guesses the pitcher using milk per drink. Streamline remembers subsequent preset selections.

autoDetect.label: Offer Auto pitcher selection
autoDetect.description: Enable automatic detection using Damian’s heuristic. Requires all three pitcher weights, gross scale weight, usual milk per drink and the pitcher normally used for one drink.
